transports.note: Carries most of the site's data; persisted queries by hash.
Three distinct sockets, not one. The chat socket tunnels IRC — a text protocol inside the frames — so a reader expecting JSON concludes the socket carries nothing useful.
transports.encoding: The hermes socket carries an encrypted envelope; the IRC socket carries text, not JSON. Encoding is a property of each socket, so neither is a separate transport row.

transports.note: Playlist needs an access token minted by a GraphQL call first, so the media URL alone looks unauthenticated and fails.
